title: The way forward for copyright, research and AI in Europe
what_changed: EIFL responded to the European Commission's targeted consultation on the EU copyright framework, asking for clarification of copyright rules for research and generative AI, transparency obligations for AI providers, and an EU-wide right of secondary publication for researchers.
why_it_matters: A secondary publication right would give researchers a legal basis to make their work open regardless of publisher contracts, and the AI rules will shape text-and-data-mining for research across the EU. This is an open-access policy question, not only a copyright one.
